DECISION: Brand name must be a filter (brand_ids), not in the search query string
OPTIONS: Put brand in search text (e.g. 'Ralph Lauren polo shirt') vs brand_ids filter + clean search text (e.g. 'polo shirt' + brand_ids=88)
REASONING: Vinted text search is fuzzy and brand in text competes with actual item description. Filter is exact match and produces much better results.
CASCADE ORDER:
1. 'polo shirt' + brand_ids=88 + color + gender catalog (most precise)
2. 'Ralph Lauren polo shirt' + color + gender catalog (brand in text, all filters)
3. 'Ralph Lauren polo shirt' + gender catalog (drop color)
4. 'Ralph Lauren polo shirt' (no filters)
5. 'polo shirt' + gender catalog (drop brand)
6. 'polo shirt' (last resort)
REVISIT WHEN: If cascade hits strategy 5+ frequently for most items
